<!--
Renders single chapters of the user guide, for a quick check while editing:

  rmarkdown::render("inst/guide/preview.Rmd",
                    params = list(chapters = "07_selectivity, 10_single_year"))

The data, life history and reference fit come from the chapters 03_quick_start
and 04_workflow, which are run silently first, together with any chapter named
in a "<!- - needs: ... - ->" line at the top of a previewed chapter.
-->

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", fig.align = "center",
                      fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r preview-setup, include = FALSE}
chapter_file <- function(x) file.path("chapters", paste0(sub("\\.Rmd$", "", x), ".Rmd"))
needs_of <- function(x) {
  l <- readLines(chapter_file(x), n = 3, warn = FALSE)
  m <- regmatches(l, regexpr("needs:[^>]*", l))
  if (!length(m)) return(character())
  trimws(strsplit(sub("-+$", "", sub("needs:", "", m)), ",")[[1]])
}
show <- trimws(strsplit(params$chapters, ",")[[1]])
show <- sub("\\.Rmd$", "", show)
deps <- character()
repeat {
  add <- setdiff(unlist(lapply(c(show, deps), needs_of)), c(show, deps))
  if (!length(add)) break
  deps <- c(deps, add)
}
base <- c("03_quick_start", "04_workflow")
hidden <- setdiff(unique(c(base, sort(deps))), show)
# run the code of the hidden chapters silently (no output)
for (f in hidden) {
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".R")
  knitr::purl(chapter_file(f), output = tmp, quiet = TRUE, documentation = 0)
  source(tmp, local = knitr::knit_global())
}
show_files <- chapter_file(show)
```

*Preview of `r paste(show, collapse = ", ")`; run silently before:
`r paste(hidden, collapse = ", ")`.*

```{r preview, child = show_files}
```
